text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a stroll to catch my breath...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this looks great.
It's dressy, yet easy to move around in.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
It looks amazing on you~!
When you wear it, Senpai,
it makes this entire place feel like a party venue!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
Since we're here, why don't you girls try something on too?

text_block_list.name: Friend Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just watching you is enough to make me happy~♪
A real feast for the eyes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a waste.
Wearing beautiful clothes is so fun, isn't it?
It makes your heart dance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daring Heart was enjoying herself with her juniors and friends. Her expression, brimming with confidence, seemed to highlight her natural charm even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —What's more.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Have you noticed how adorable your eyes look, sparkling so brightly whenever you compliment me?

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh... M-Me!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, you♪ With that smile of yours... I think a brighter color, in slacks like mine, would look wonderful on you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And you too! You have such great posture and figure, so hold your head high! No slouching, it's such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Friend Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If you're standing next to me, stand proud! Let's make it look cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps due to her high self-esteem, she never hesitates to praise others. She never feels the need to compare herself with those around her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Training to build self-confidence? Fufu. I've never even thought about or tried anything like that.
choice_data_list: Then is it just your natural personality?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Who knows? I'm sure that's part of it, of course, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm. What really comes to mind is definitely my mother.

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, wait right there!
I'll be right over.
I'm gonna run super fast♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text: —Eek!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Heart! ...Oh, what a graceful tumble.
Amazing, you're not hurt at all!
You can definitely still run with that.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now, stand up!
Show me the beautiful way you run!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No matter what mistake I made, my mom would always find something positive in it. That's why taking on challenges was always fun.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: When I was really little, I raced my mom and lost. It was only natural, of course... but I still wanted to win so badly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I was sulking a bit and skipped dinner to train instead, and then she said to me:

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "So you don't intend to win, what a relief. If you won't eat, that means Mommy wins again!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...she said. Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: She really knew how to push the right buttons for a competitive child, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her mother clearly knew exactly how to keep one's spirits lifted. So much so that there was never any time to hang one's head in sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if such strength of heart can't be acquired overnight, continuously conveying positivity day after day could become an immense source of support.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And that's how I ended up standing here today. I don't know if any of this will be useful to you, though.
choice_data_list: Thank you for sharing that with me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Though you know... I feel like you're quite similar to my mom. In your overall aura, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You have eyes that are always searching for the positive. I can feel your desire to turn even negatives into positives.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Whoever is in your care must be very fortunate indeed!
choice_data_list: ...You're quite good at giving compliments yourself.
...You're quite skilled at praising others too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu! I get told that a lot!
